separation_of_evidence.controller_acceptance_receipt_A: created AFTER E is pushed; binds remote branch -> E; reruns tests, harness, artifacts, rebuild; final verdict
separation_of_evidence.rule: A is NEVER included inside E

top_level_keys.policy: all required keys present; unknown top-level keys rejected; forbidden self-binding keys rejected

validation_rules: C, R, E resolvable; R^ == C; E^ == R; R != C; diff C R nonzero
envelope ABSENT from C/R, PRESENT in E; diff R..E exactly the envelope path
lab/batch/leaf/lease exact; OIDs exact; object format exact; planned branch exact
leaf_literal_tests: exact ID set == batch-manifest IDs; command_sha256 byte-exact; exit 0; timestamps ordered
artifacts: exact set == C..R tracked changes; sha256/size from R blobs; kinds allowed; NEVER empty
